title: HTTP Signature verification is thorough and correct
description: src/inbox.rs:500-619. The signature verification flow is well-structured: Date freshness check (5-min window), required headers ((request-target), digest, date, host), keyId-to-actor anti-spoofing, cached key with re-fetch on failure (handles key rotation), and replay protection via HMAC of (actor, date, digest). This is a carefully layered defense. The replay window is scoped to 10 minutes matching the date freshness window. The re-fetch path prevents cache poisoning from blocking legitimate key rotations.
